terminal.description: Terminal application used for viewers that require a terminal.

execute_command.description: Command to pass to the terminal application to load an external command within the terminal. Most terminal emulators support '-e' for this command.

preview_groups.description: List of preview configuration groups defining how to handle file types inside .deb packages. Each group must have a unique name and specify matching pattern, viewer, and behavior flags. Order matters — first match wins. Default group [deb-gview] must appear first, then preview rules follow in order of specificity.
